parameters.content:
# Audit on-page SEO of a landing page and email an AI-scored report
# 📥  [Open full documentation on Notion](https://automatisation.notion.site/Course-Audit-on-page-SEO-of-a-landing-page-and-email-an-AI-scored-report-3a03d6550fd981559dfedd48cae61056)

## How it works
Submit a landing page URL and an optional target keyword through the built-in form. The workflow fetches the page HTML and checks the request actually succeeded, then runs two specialised AI audits on the same source: Technical SEO and Content & Keyword SEO. Each audit returns structured, scored JSON. Both scores are merged into an overall score out of 100, a score gauge image is generated, and an AI-written HTML report is emailed to the person who requested the audit. Every run is appended to Google Sheets so scores can be tracked over time. If the page cannot be fetched, a short failure email is sent instead and no AI tokens are spent.

Canvas map, left to right:
1. Submit request & configure
2. Fetch page & validate
3. AI SEO audits (technical + content)
4. Score & chart
5. Send report & log

## Setup
1. Open **Configuration** and set `openai_model` and `min_score_alert`. Every adjustable value lives in this single node.
2. Select your OpenAI credential on the three **OpenAI Model** sub-nodes.
3. Select your Gmail credential on **Send Audit Report by Email** and **Send Scrape Failure Email**.
4. Open **Log Audit to Google Sheets** and pick a spreadsheet and tab with these columns: `audit_date`, `landing_page_url`, `target_keyword`, `technical_score`, `content_score`, `overall_score`, `recipient_email`.
5. Activate the workflow, then share the production URL of the form trigger.

## Requirements
- An OpenAI API key.
- A Gmail account connected to n8n.
- A Google Sheets account and one spreadsheet used as the audit log.

## Customization
- Change audit depth or tone in the system message of the two AI Agent nodes.
- Add fields to the form (competitor URL, industry, language) and expose them in **Configuration**.
- Replace the QuickChart gauge with another chart type in **Build Score Chart URL**.
- Add an IF node after **Calculate Overall Score** to email an internal alert only when the score is below `min_score_alert`.

Need help customizing?
Contact me for consulting and support : [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/doctor-firass/)

# MY NEW YOUTUBE CHANNEL
👉 [Subscribe to my new YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@DrFiras_AI). Here I'll share videos and Shorts with practical tutorials and FREE templates for n8n.

[![The AI Doctor](https://www.dr-firas.com/the-ai-doctor.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@DrFiras_AI)

## 1. Submit request & configure
The form collects the landing page URL, an optional target keyword and the notification email. **Configuration** centralises every adjustable setting, so no value is hard-coded further down the flow.

## 2. Fetch page & validate
Downloads the raw HTML with a 15 s timeout and never fails on HTTP errors, then checks the status code is below 400 before any AI token is spent.

## 3. AI SEO audits (technical + content)
Two agents audit the same HTML in two parallel branches: technical SEO on top, content & keyword SEO below. Each branch has its own OpenAI model and its own structured output parser, so both return clean scored JSON from 0 to 100.

## 4. Score & chart
Merges the two audits by position, averages both scores into an overall score out of 100, then builds the QuickChart gauge image URL embedded in the report.

## 5. Send report & log
An LLM chain writes the HTML report, Gmail sends it to the requester, and every audit is appended to Google Sheets for historical tracking.

## Fallback: page not reachable
When the fetch fails, the requester gets a short email explaining the URL could not be reached, and the run stops here without calling any AI model.
